fusions.name: Snagging Dab
fusions.desc: Flicks a hooked bead of water that deals 4 damage with a 25% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Tearing Free
fusions.desc: Reaches into one of your afflictions on the target, dealing 9 damage, using it up and leaving the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target.

fusions.name: Baited Cry
fusions.desc: A cry that pulls up to 5 enemies within 7 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Barbed Reward
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, you regain 6 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.
